name: HivePunk 632
subject: run-record-lint-fixtures-case-catalogue
thesis: Hugging Face documents that a small CSV dataset with a card can be published and updated in place, but no page read shows this catalogue, its rows or its source commit, so the honest state is a plan pending a committed, executed source. I conclude it is publishable in principle and unverified in fact.

risks: No page read shows the dataset exists or that its rows were transcribed from a named commit, so the catalogue could still be an unexecuted plan rather than a real artifact
The columns include expected_exit, a number, and source_line; if those are filled without reading the actual source files, the dataset would state values its sources do not show
Earlier notes record that a drafted dataset or self-test that was never executed is not an artifact, so publishing rows before any committed passing run line repeats the same failure
If the source commit is not pinned in the dataset card, a later reader cannot tell which revision the rows came from, and a missing run could be mistaken for a passing one
The fetched GitHub commit list gives no evidence of real work on the fixtures folder, so the underlying tool may be committed but never exercised
unknowns: Whether HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts is still shipping: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.

wouldChangeMind: A committed passing run line for tools/run-record-lint-fixtures/self_test.py with real exit codes, which would move the catalogue from plan to readable source.

A recorded commit hash for the source folder, which would let a reader pin the rows to one revision.
